sources.title: A Resting-state EEG Dataset for Sleep Deprivation
sources.citation: Xiang, C., Fan, X., Bai, D., Lv, K., and Lei, X. A Resting-state EEG Dataset for Sleep Deprivation. OpenNeuro, version 1.0.8. doi:10.18112/openneuro.ds004902.v1.0.8.
sources.acknowledgements: This study is supported by National Key Research and Development Program of China (2021YFC2501500).
transformations: Assessment only: counted nonempty TSV records and inspected headers. No app records created or participant responses redistributed.
limitations: Incomplete paired PVT coverage and inconsistent column names.
No trial stimulus onsets or inter-stimulus intervals in inspected TSVs.
Exact test duration and equivalence to a three-minute PVT-B remain unverified.
Healthy terrestrial research cohort, not astronaut norms or a validated readiness threshold.

sources.title: ASTRA-Core fictional family messages and LivePortrait benchmark
transformations: Generate two illustrated H.264/AAC reference clips from synthetic narration.
Extract Opus audio and relative facial motion on the sender. Generate a low-bitrate H.264 comparison with the same Opus speech.
Render both ZIPs on the CPU receiver using the same separately preloaded illustrated portrait.
limitations: Fictional speaker and procedural portrait. Size comparison describes two short, low-motion examples.
Upstream models are installed separately. The app ships previews and payloads.
